slides.text: In ages past, man held the power to remake the world.
Societies rose and fell, centered around a relic of unimaginable power.

A relic now lost
to the sands of time.

The world has moved on,
into a brighter future.

But some things
don't stay buried.

And all thanks to
your little cat...

The world faces
Cataclysm once more.
